info.description: API for schedule import/read, attendance processing and study plan management.
info.title: CourseJob API

get.description: Returns users with optional role/email filters. Requires Bearer token with admin role.

post.description: Creates teacher or admin account. Requires Bearer token with admin role.

patch.description: Updates user is_active status. Requires Bearer token with admin role.
Updates user role. Allowed roles: teacher or admin. Requires Bearer token with admin role.

post.description: Accepts a session with scans and stores attendance events.

get.description: Returns unique groups for the selected course from schedule data.
Returns planned pairs grouped by subject for the selected course.

put.description: Creates or updates planned pairs by course and subject.

get.description: Returns all rooms from the catalog.
Returns schedule grouped by weeks with optional filters.

post.description: Imports one course schedule chunk and publishes an SSE update event.

get.description: Opens an SSE stream and sends `schedule_updated` events when schedule import succeeds.

post.description: Creates one student from an object payload or many students from an array payload.

parameters.description: Student payload (single object or array of objects)
parameters.name: request

get.description: Returns attendance records and summary for the current authenticated student.
Returns all subjects from the catalog.
Returns all teachers from the catalog.

post.description: Authenticates by email and password and returns access token.
Issues a new access/refresh token pair using a valid refresh token.
Registers a student user and creates both student profile and user account in one transaction.
Revokes a refresh token so it can no longer be used.

get.description: Verifies shutdown flag and database availability.
